Available tools:
- read: Read a file; each line returned as anchor│content

`read`: call again after an edit when you need anchors you lack — post-edit diff `+anchor│`/` anchor│` rows and any served `anchor│content` rows already carry fresh anchors for the changed range.

`replace`: path resolution is anchor-only; don't pass `path`.
`insert`: path resolution is anchor-only; don't pass `path`.
`undo_last_change`: only the last `replace`/`insert` per file is undoable; a `write` clears it, so undo right after a bad diff — review the diff's `-anchor│` rows first to confirm what you're restoring.
